d:
Sometimes all we need is less noise, less action, less input. Sometimes all we need is silence.
Not to escape, not to hide, but to return. To reset the nervous system, to calm the mind, to remember who we are underneath all the doing and the constant stream of impressions the world asks us to absorb.
Silence is not empty. Silence is full. It holds the things we haven't had time to feel yet, the answers we've been too busy to hear.
May your days be filled with love, joy and silent prayer.
